name: A10-0290/2026 – Emma Ytterell – After recital 37 – Am 120
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: (37a) Member States should be able to designate projects as strategic, based on objective and published criteria established by the competent national authority, if such projects contribute significantly to the security of a reliable, affordable, and continuous energy supply or are essential for food security and the maintenance of agricultural production and processing capacities. Energy security should be assessed independently of technology and should include, in particular, secured generation capacity, energy storage, and transmission and distribution networks. With regard to food security, projects relating to primary agricultural production, livestock farming, the supply of feed and fertilisers, irrigation, storage, refrigeration, processing, and the transport of agricultural products may be particularly important. The classification is carried out by the Member State without prior approval or confirmation from the Commission. Projects should be granted access to the instruments listed in the Annex in accordance with the respective conditions. The requirements of the relevant environmental directives remain unaffected.
